title: Hydra Cabbage Puzzle Garden
description: A surreal scene featuring a five-headed turquoise hydra with yellow eyes emerging from a large green cabbage puzzle. The central black cat sits on the hydra's neck emitting glowing symbols. Six identical women in teal patterned dresses and wide green hats stand in a circle holding glowing green leafy shapes.
prompt: Surreal fantasy illustration of a multi-headed turquoise hydra with glowing yellow eyes rising from an oversized green cabbage made of interlocking puzzle pieces. A small black cat with glowing purple aura sits on the central neck. Six identical elegant women with long dark hair wearing flowing teal patterned dresses and wide-brimmed green hats stand in a circular formation around the creature, each holding a glowing green plant element. Scattered black puzzle pieces, musical notes, and the words 'forge', 'garden', 'elixir' float in a purple and green gradient background.
